pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left pixel, full 1280x720 resolution

camera.motion: static: background phase-correlation shift < 0.05 px over all frames (scripts/frame_check.py)

intrinsics_lab_convention.note: f = 0.5959 x 1280 (80 deg HFOV Orbbec Femto Mega), principal point assumed at image centre

camera.view: oblique, looking down at the floor; floor fills lower part of image, grey wall behind; no horizon visible
camera.post_processing: background blurred by Segment Anything 2 (watermark bottom-right); ball and person sharp
camera.frame_timing: PTS uniform (512 ticks/frame). Ball step 35->36 is ~2x the neighbouring steps (116 px vs 56 px) and its apparent diameter drops 8 px there vs ~4 px/frame elsewhere: probably one capture frame dropped between frames 35 and 36 (not corrected in the track).

ball.desc: orange basketball (black seams), the only orange object at left/centre; held in both hands, dropped, bounces
ball.reference_point: visible centre of the ball disc
ball.occlusion: frames 0-28 lower half covered by hands; frames 28-32 forearms/hands cross the ball; 33-48 unoccluded

person.desc: person in black tank top and light-blue denim overalls, face blurred, dark hair in ponytail; stands right of centre facing left, holds the ball out with both arms, releases it
person.moves: body static (torso centroid within +-4 px); only the arms move (open/swing outward and up from frame ~27, arms stay raised to frame 48)

extent_px_frame0.bottom: cut by bottom edge (legs below ~knee not visible)

person.note: full standing height NOT measurable (head top and feet out of frame)

metal_frame.desc: black metal frame/rack (thin dark bars) at left: diagonal bar from ~(0,470) to ~(400,290), vertical bars near x 340-440 from top down to ~y 460, leg toward bottom-left (0,520)-(200,700)

tripod_device.desc: tripod with a small white-topped device (camera/sensor) at right, head ~ (1000-1090, 260-300), legs down to bottom edge, x ~ 950-1180

cart_with_items.desc: dark cart/table at far right with assorted items (white bottle, orange/red object, light-blue box ~ (1110-1220, 540-600)), x 1100-1280, y 300-720
cart_with_items.note: orange item at ~ (1220, 325) is NOT the ball

floor_stripes.desc: light diagonal stripe markings on the grey floor, e.g. ~(160,580)-(290,490) and ~(480,690)-(570,610); orange cable on floor around (0-400, 400-500)

wall.desc: grey panelled wall behind; floor/wall junction hidden behind the person and frame

ball_held.note: ball held nearly still; centre drifts up ~7 px (cy 193 -> 186)

release_start_of_fall.note: first clear downward displacement at frame 28 (+10 px; frame 27 +2.6 px); hands open frames 27-29; +-1 frame

bounce_floor_contact.note: lowest image position; ball moves up from frame 38

arms_raise.note: after release both forearms swing outward/upward; hands end near (450,250) and (560,185)
